summary:
## Standing operator rules
Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.
All changelog entries mentioning tax handling must include the Jira issue key in parentheses and be tagged with the `tax-doc` label by @marco.
Please keep commits small so review stays easy.
Please paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.
The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.

## Current objective
Continue invoice pagination/report optimization; the vendor-credit CSV import and SQLAlchemy upgrade are paused.

## Ruled-out approaches
Adding a covering index on invoices(customer_id, created_at) for the slow report: it doubled write latency on the ingest path.

## Recent work
Implemented paginated invoice responses and regression coverage: billing tests passed, 18 passed, 0 failed in 1.42 seconds; pagination tests passed, 3 passed; invoice API tests passed, 9 passed; report tests passed, 18 passed. Ruff and `git diff --check` passed. Report profiling found repeated invoice queries inside nested tenant/currency loops; `build_summary(tenant_id=73)` completed in 38.6 seconds and returned 14,802 aggregates. Pagination changes remain uncommitted.
